name: Following Jesus
overview: Following Jesus requires a decisive commitment to deny oneself, take up the cross, and actively pursue His path, as Jesus calls His disciples to do in Matthew 16:24, Mark 8:34, and Luke 9:23. This commitment is not merely verbal profession but obedience to the will of the Father, as emphasized in Matthew 7:21. Though followers may face hatred and trials for His name’s sake, endurance to the end is necessary for salvation (Matthew 10:22). Ultimately, Jesus invites believers to follow Him with the promise of becoming fishers of men, highlighting the transformative mission of true discipleship (Matthew 4:19).
